# ops legacy

ship the old way

This command is deprecated since 1.4.0, removed in 2.0.0: renamed; use ops deploy instead

## Usage

```
ops legacy
```

## Global Flags

- `-h, --help` — print help
- `-v, --verbose` — say more; repeat to count: -vvv
- `--color` `string` — when to color (default `auto`) (one of `auto`, `always`, `never`)

## Exit Status

- `0` — done
- `3` (`unreachable`) — the fleet did not answer (retryable)
